description: Staging invitation emails for publication, cancellation and rescheduling.

preconditions: A Published meeting with 2 active participants and 1 Guest, moved from 09:00 to 14:00 on the same day.
cases.return: No result. Three Rescheduled dispatches staged with key roster:H2:Rescheduled:<owner id>.
cases.log: Each payload holds PreviousStartsAt 09:00 and PreviousEndsAt 10:30. No in-app notification is staged here; the caller adds it, leaving out the organizer who moved the meeting.

preconditions: A meeting with no active participants and no Guests.
